notes.subject: Yawe
notes.rationale: Salmukɛla bɛ Yawe wele ka a tila sanfɛ — kumasen in ye Ala la gafɛ ye

notes.subject: ɲɛfɔ
notes.rationale: זמר ka kɔrɔ ye ka ka donkili minɛn tawanw fɛ — Bamanankan tɛ daɲɛ kelen sɔn o cogo la, 'ɲɛfɔ' (ka fɔ a ɲɛfɛ) dɔgɔya dɔ bi yen

notes.subject: נשירה/ונזמרה
notes.rationale: Daɲɛ filaw ninu bɛ donkili-kɛli fɔ, u bɛ ɲɔgɔn lamini — kumasen in ka ngarabaw jɔya Bamanankan na dɔgɔya dɔ

translation: Yawe, i tila sanfɛ ni i ka sebagaw ye; an bɛna donkili da ani an bɛna i ka fanga ɲɛfɔ.
